title: kith-peer: is_valid_mailbox_host accepts malformed hostnames like a..b.ts.net
description: is_valid_mailbox_host accepts any string ending in '.ts.net' that passes the character set check. 'a..b.ts.net' passes (consecutive dots = empty label), '.ts.net' itself passes. These are not valid DNS names. Fix: add label-by-label validation after the ends_with check — no empty labels, each label ≤ 63 chars, total ≤ 253 chars.
